title: Coach Bill Bro Split (Arms and Legs Focus)
author: Eric King
desc:
Push 
Legs
Back
Off
Arms
Legs
Off

*RP is a rest pause set, do these in a DC training style fashion. The rep range is TOTAL reps between the 3 mini sets so 16-24 should look like 12x6x3=21 reps, next week repeat the same weight and shoot for 22. Once you get to 24, increase the weight by 2.5-5lbs. 

We can add volume to the target areas, arms and legs, so long as we’re progressing and recovering. Usually this is 1 set to a main exercise, every 2 weeks.

ex.note: On triceps movements, we are not going to failure. We want to stop 1-2 reps short of failure with plenty of warm up sets
Bend elbows and take it to a mini triceps extension at the end of the rep.
Don't go near failure. Get blood flowing and pumping.
The rep range is TOTAL reps between the 3 mini sets so 16-24 should look like 12x6x3=21 reps, next week repeat the same weight and shoot for 22. Once you get to 24, increase the weight by 2.5-5lbs.

Once you get 16 on first set, increase weight. 
*3min rest between sets

*3 sec negative 
*5 sec stretch at bottom
*Set cable just below waist to be able to pull on an even plane with the ROM
*Set cable just below waist to be able to pull on an even plane with the ROM
Warm Up Set's

Pick a weight you can get for 6 reps. Once you work up to 10 reps with that weight, increase weight and to get 6 reps. Repeat the process.

3-minute rest between sets

ex.n: Squat (Any Variation) Work Up To All Out Top Set Of 10 With Multiple Warm Up Sets
ex.note:
*Work your way up to this set may look like 
135x8
185x8
225x8
245x5
275x5
*Top set 315x10
*Take 2-3min between sets

ex.n: Single Leg Press (Mid Platform Foot Placement)
ex.note:
Keep tension the entire time, ½ reps and do not lock out, PUMP THE REPS!!

**May need 1-2 warm up sets
Really focus on the eccentric, almost flex as you’re lowering the weight
This is a skill lift.

ex.n: Single Arm Neutral Grip Pull Down
ex.note: All out sets here. Work some feeder sets into a hard set of 12 (No RIR) keep the weight the same, rest 2 minutes and don't get less than 9 reps on 2nd set.
Warm up to a hard set of 15, then stay at that weight and do another all-out set

ss.note: RP is a rest pause set. The rep range is TOTAL reps between the 3 mini sets so 16-24 should look like 12x6x3=21 reps, next week repeat the same weight and shoot for 22. when you get 24 increase weight

ex.note: 3-second negatives and 2-second contractions.

ss.note: RP is a rest pause set. The rep range is TOTAL reps between the 3 mini sets so 16-24 should look like 12x6x3=21 reps, next week repeat the same weight and shoot for 22. when you get 24 increase weight

ex.note: 3-second negatives. Shoot for 20 reps but no less than 8.
Flex HARD at the top for 2 seconds and control the weight really well and stable on the way down.

ss.note: After 2nd set allow the barbell to STRETCH into your fingers and hold for 60 seconds.
